input.prompt: Editorial still-life photograph for a premium sparkling spring water. A matte pale sage-green aluminium can and a short clear tumbler of sparkling water with rising bubbles stand on a rough slab of pink Canadian Shield granite. Hard, low morning sunlight from the left casts long crisp shadows across a warm bone-coloured plaster wall. Objects sit on the right third of the frame; generous empty wall on the left. Tactile textures, real condensation, natural colour, medium-format film look with fine grain, quiet and confident. A small minimal label on the can reads ALDER in black serif capitals, nothing else. No other text, no logos.
